findings.claim: USER-GATE-D criterion (i) weakens the FLA-mandatory requirement from plan-doc §8 — allows Threshold A with SCP-self + any two external adopters, bypassing FLA as named canary.
findings.evidence: Plan-doc §8 Threshold A: '≥3 estate adopters listed in docs/scorecards/opt-in-registry.yaml (FLA + 2 of {PIM, recommender, mapp-doc-agent, control-tower}).' Plan-doc §5 narrative: 'Threshold A criterion: at least 3 estate adopters opted in (FLA + 2 of {PIM, recommender, mapp-doc-agent, control-tower}).' Plan-doc §10 Q6: 'FLA is the canary; the other 2 of 3 should be the most cooperative adopters at the time of 023E. Likely PIM + control-tower. Reaffirm at 023E.' DISPATCH-NOTE §OUT: '≥3 real adopters opting in | External coordination' — DISPATCH-NOTE explicitly distinguishes 'real adopters' (external) from SCP-self (a dogfood test corpus). USER-GATE-D criterion (i): 'at least 3 entries; SCP-self counts as 1, so ≥2 of {FLA / PIM / recommender / mapp-doc-agent / control-tower} also need entries.' This formulation allows SCP-self + PIM + control-tower = 3 to satisfy the gate without FLA participating — directly contradicting plan-doc §8 which treats FLA as a named mandatory participant, not an optional member of a pool.
findings.impact: USER-GATE-D is the Threshold A gate artefact — it will govern when WP-SCP-023 can be declared closed. A gate criterion weaker than the plan-doc definition means the operator could ratify Threshold A without the FLA canary adopter that the plan explicitly required as the observability pilot. FLA was designated as 'the canary' for a reason: it is the reference executable gold standard (reference_fla_gold_standard.md) and its scorecard conformance signals are the highest-value first data point. Silently allowing FLA substitution undermines the observability goal of the WP and creates a precedent where gate artefacts diverge from plan-doc definitions without an explicit decision.
findings.mitigation: Amend USER-GATE-D criterion (i) to: '(i) ≥3 estate adopters opted in, with FLA mandatory. Verified by reading docs/scorecards/opt-in-registry.yaml — at least 3 entries; FLA entry is required; SCP-self counts as 1 (dogfood corpus), so FLA + ≥1 of {PIM / recommender / mapp-doc-agent / control-tower} must also be present as the remaining 2 non-self entries.' This matches plan-doc §8 literally and preserves the plan-doc §10 Q6 FLA-as-canary intent. If the operator later decides at 023E time that a different adopter should substitute for FLA, that substitution must be ratified via an explicit decision row in DECISIONS.md (not a silent gate-criterion weakening).
